hints.title: Precompute Mismatch Costs per Substring
hints.text: Calculate cost[i][j], the minimum character changes to make substring s[i..j] a palindrome.

hints.title: Partition String into K Groups
hints.text: Let dp[p][j] be the minimum changes to partition prefix s[0..j] into p palindromic substrings.

hints.title: Iterate Transition Boundaries
hints.text: For each group count p from 1 to k, test all split points i to minimize dp[p - 1][i - 1] + cost[i][j].

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all partitions and counting mismatches takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputed mismatch table in O(N^2) enables partition DP in O(k * N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should decouple substring modification costs from the partition DP recurrence.
complexity.notes: cost[i][j] is the count of unequal mirror positions between i and j.
